definition: Adaptability is the ability to adjust readily to changes in the environment. In psychology, it can be assessed as a characteristic of how well a person responds to changing situations.

provenance.scope: Source record C121295; pinned source text

reasons: The second sentence is unsupported: the packet only says adaptability is measured by a rating scale in the Behavior Assessment System for Children, not that it is generally assessed in psychology as a characteristic of how well a person responds to changing situations.

The packet content describes an “Adaptability Scale” (a rating scale) that measures adaptability, but the definition does not mention this scale and instead generalizes that adaptability “can be assessed as a characteristic.”

The provided packet supports measuring “the ability of the subject to adapt readily to changes in the environment,” but it does not support the specific framing that adaptability is assessed “as a characteristic of how well a person responds to changing situations.”
